Pinned file/ancestor handles span hash, version and file-metadata inspection; loaded/file metadata consistency is checked. Report admission is new-only and bounded. Output failure returns reportWritten false and no permission; fatal or unobserved completion is not a pass.

Exact 23-field, 8-KiB process-bound purpose lease rejects unknown/duplicate fields and all activation opt-ins. Generated production policy fixes paths and scope, never reviewed API identity. Authentic SDK compilation is separate from actual runtime authentication.

All diagnostic compilations use the authentic SDK. Default 655-method comparison retains method bodies and initializer content.

Lease cleanup depends on its generated ownership receipt. Unknown changes are preserved; no wildcard, recursive or ASI deletion is admitted.
